unconstrained_3b_attempt.reason: Malformed JSON and explanatory prose around a bare array; author batch fails closed on any format error. Stopped before QA and enabled author-supported JSON-object response_format in a fresh index namespace.

resume_note: Pinned Python hash seed before graph construction; resumed identical extraction requests from native per-request cache without replacing model or embeddings.
index_resume: force_index_from_scratch=True explicitly rebuilds graph while retaining compatible embeddings, extraction state and native per-request LLM cache; required by author safety guard after interruption before graph creation.

native_format_guard.behavior: Call the unmodified native extraction parser, truncated-JSON fixer and triple filter; keep accepted responses unchanged. Retry only parser/type failures with a task-specific JSON schema, at most three attempts, seeds base plus attempt. Do not judge or correct facts.
native_format_guard.cache_reuse: Compatible native per-request cache from earlier structured attempt; fresh graph and vector-index namespace. Cache keys bind endpoint, model, generation parameters and prompt.
native_format_guard.trigger: One triple response contained an integer where native filter_invalid_triples calls len(); the actual rejected passage passed a schema retry smoke check before QA.
